name: Caribbean Cruise Slow-Roasted Pork Loin (Pernil) & Grilled Red Snapper with Yucca
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure, Magic & Wonder · Caribbean Cruise Rotational & Cabanas/Marceline
whyItWorks: Flaky Caribbean red snapper and tender slow-roasted pork loin paired with starchy boiled yucca (cassava) or white rice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the red snapper or center-cut pork loin plain with olive oil and steamed white rice or boiled yucca—requesting no sour-orange/lime mojo marinade.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Traditional Caribbean pernil and fish marinades use sour orange or lime juice—order plain
